stage: exposed development; rules fixed before stationary embedded DFT calculations
anchor: restricted stationary PBE0 within the retained isometric valence embedding, full DFT core orbitals frozen
reuse: retained full DFT reference, embedding, projected ERIs, previous corrected-ground seed; resume all new checkpoints
anchor_energy_origin: fixed frozen-core additive constant omitted; no excitation offset
response: full projected charge/spin PBE0 Hessian evaluated at this stationary embedded density
F_parent: native GFN2 plus linear and quadratic correction centered at the new density, matching projected anchor Fock and response
Q_parent: same density and response; qualified full-reference DFT spacings mapped onto compact stationary canonical orbitals, overlap >= 0.7, margin >= 0.05, occupied-centroid gauge
excited_solver: spin-pure rank-one ROKS stationary KKT, explicit ground orthogonality, guarded state continuation
ground_gate: stationary positive-curvature restricted minimum at the calibration density
